description: Automated test suite expansion: CRUD feature tests for wallets/goals/categories/budgets, API v1 feature tests, security tests (CSRF, rate limiting, honeypot, XSS/SQL injection), calculator/simulator smoke tests, and unit tests for TransactionService, BudgetService, GoalService. All new tests must pass under composer test. Independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 (can be written against existing code; FEAT-002's honeypot-on-login addition is tested here).
steps: WALLET CRUD TESTS: create tests/Feature/WalletCrudTest.php. Use RefreshDatabase trait. setUp creates $this->user = User::factory()->create(). Tests: (a) test_authenticated_user_can_create_wallet — POST wallets.store with valid data (name='Conta Corrente', type='checking', balance=1000, color='#3B82F6') as $this->user, assertRedirect to wallets.index, assertDatabaseHas wallets. (b) test_free_plan_cannot_create_second_wallet — create first wallet via factory, POST wallets.store with second wallet data, assertRedirect (back to index with error session key). (c) test_user_can_update_own_wallet — create wallet, PUT wallets.update with new name, assertRedirect, assertDatabaseHas with new name. (d) test_user_can_delete_own_wallet — create wallet, DELETE wallets.destroy, assertRedirect, assertSoftDeleted. (e) test_pay_invoice_requires_valid_ref — POST wallets.invoice.pay with ref='invalid', assertSessionHasErrors('ref'). (f) test_pay_invoice_source_cannot_be_same_as_card — POST wallets.invoice.pay with source_wallet_id equal to the card wallet id, assertSessionHasErrors('source_wallet_id'). Import App\Models\Wallet, User. Follow the pattern in tests/Feature/TransactionLifecycleTest.php for setUp and helpers.

GOAL CRUD TESTS: create tests/Feature/GoalCrudTest.php. Tests: (a) test_user_can_create_goal — POST goals.store with name='Viagem', target_amount='5000', deadline=now()->addYear()->toDateString(), assertRedirect, assertDatabaseHas goals. (b) test_user_can_update_goal — create via factory, PUT goals.update with new target_amount, assertDatabaseHas updated amount. (c) test_user_can_delete_goal — DELETE goals.destroy, assertSoftDeleted or assertDatabaseMissing. (d) test_intruder_cannot_update_or_delete_other_users_goal — create goal for $owner, actingAs $intruder, PUT goals.update → assertNotFound (or 403), DELETE goals.destroy → assertNotFound. Use App\Models\Goal factory.

CATEGORY AND BUDGET CRUD TESTS: create tests/Feature/CategoryBudgetCrudTest.php. Category tests: (a) test_user_can_create_category — POST categories.store, assertRedirect, assertDatabaseHas. (b) test_free_plan_cannot_exceed_category_limit — create 5 categories via factory, POST a 6th, assertRedirect with error session. (c) test_import_suggested_creates_default_categories — POST categories.import-suggested, assert at least 1 category now exists (from CategoryService::suggestedCategories). Budget tests: (d) test_user_can_store_budget — POST budgets.store with category_id, amount, year, month, assertRedirect, assertDatabaseHas budgets. (e) test_free_plan_cannot_exceed_budget_limit — create 3 budgets for same month, POST a 4th, assertRedirect with error session. (f) test_copy_previous_month_duplicates_budgets — create 3 budgets for month N-1, POST budgets.copy-previous with target month=N, assert 3 new budgets for month N.

REPORT EXPORT TESTS: create tests/Feature/ReportExportTest.php. Use SubscriptionFactory (see tests/Feature/BudgetInvoiceRecurringTest.php for the pattern) to make a user Professional. Tests: (a) test_free_plan_cannot_export_csv — actingAs free user, GET reports.export, assertForbidden or assertRedirect. (b) test_professional_can_export_csv — actingAs professional user, GET reports.export with query params type=expense&year=now()->year, assertOk, assertDownload content-type text/csv. (c) test_professional_can_generate_pdf — GET reports.pdf, assertOk. (d) test_email_report_is_throttled — POST reports.email twice in quick succession, second call assertStatus(429) or assert it is redirected with error. Use Mail::fake() for the email assertion.

API V1 FEATURE TESTS: create tests/Feature/ApiV1Test.php. Tests use the Sanctum token API (prefix /api/v1). (a) test_guest_cannot_access_api — GET /api/v1/wallets without token, assertUnauthorized (401). (b) test_user_can_create_api_token — POST settings.tokens.store, assert response has 'token' key, assertDatabaseHas personal_access_tokens. (c) test_api_wallet_crud — with Sanctum token header: GET /api/v1/wallets (assertOk, assertJsonStructure), POST /api/v1/wallets (assertCreated), PUT /api/v1/wallets/{id} (assertOk), DELETE /api/v1/wallets/{id} (assertNoContent or 204). (d) test_api_transaction_crud — POST /api/v1/transactions to create, GET /api/v1/transactions to list (assertOk, assertJsonFragment with created transaction). (e) test_api_cross_user_isolation — create wallet for user A, authenticated as user B request GET /api/v1/wallets/{id} → assertNotFound. Use $this->withToken(token) or withHeaders(['Authorization' => 'Bearer '.$token]) pattern. Import Laravel\Sanctum\Sanctum or use actingAs with 'sanctum' guard.

SECURITY TESTS: create tests/Feature/Security/CsrfProtectionTest.php. Test: test_post_without_csrf_returns_419 — disable VerifyCsrfToken middleware temporarily by calling $this->withoutMiddleware([\App\Http\Middleware\VerifyCsrfToken::class]), then re-enable it and do a POST to wallets.store without '_token', assertStatus(419). Actually the simpler approach: do not send '_token' at all and assert the CSRF middleware returns 419. Use withoutMiddleware() to prove it passes WITH the token; without it, do a raw $this->call('POST', route('wallets.store'), []) without csrf token to get 419. Create tests/Feature/Security/RateLimitTest.php. Test: test_too_many_login_attempts_returns_429 — attempt POST route('login') with wrong credentials 6 times in a loop (the LoginRequest has a 5-attempt rate limit), assert the last response is 429 or assertStatus(429). Create tests/Feature/Security/HoneypotTest.php. Tests: (a) test_register_with_honeypot_filled_is_rejected — POST route('register') with website='bot@spam.com' (the honeypot field filled), assert response is not a redirect to login (should be a 422/redirect with validation error). (b) test_login_with_honeypot_filled_is_rejected — POST route('login') with website='bot@spam.com', assertSessionHasErrors or assert 422. Create tests/Feature/Security/XssInjectionTest.php. Tests: (a) test_script_tag_in_description_is_stored_escaped — create a transaction with description='<script>alert(1)</script>', GET transactions.show, assertDontSee('<script>') in response body (Blade escapes by default). (b) test_malformed_search_does_not_cause_500 — GET transactions.index with search param set to a SQL injection string like "' OR '1'='1", assertOk (must not return 500).

CALCULATOR SMOKE TESTS: create tests/Feature/CalculatorSmokeTest.php. All 7 calculator routes + 6 simulator routes require auth and terms acceptance. Tests: (a) test_all_calculator_pages_return_200 — actingAs $user (with terms accepted), GET all 7 calculator routes (calculators.index, calculators.investment, calculators.interest, calculators.retirement, calculators.thirteenth-salary, calculators.vacation, calculators.financing, calculators.currency), each assertOk. (b) test_all_simulator_pages_return_200 — but only Professional users see simulators without redirect — use SubscriptionFactory to make a Professional user, GET simulators.index, simulators.investment, simulators.retirement, simulators.budget, simulators.financial-profile, simulators.investor-profile, each assertOk.

UNIT TESTS FOR SERVICES: create tests/Unit/Services/TransactionServiceTest.php. This tests the service directly (no HTTP). Instantiate via app(TransactionServiceInterface::class) in a Laravel TestCase with RefreshDatabase. Tests: (a) test_summary_returns_income_and_expense_totals — create paid income 500, paid expense 200, pending expense 100 for the same user and month, call getSummary, assert income_paid=500.00, expense_paid=200.00. (b) test_installment_penny_distribution — verify that createInstallments for 100 / 3 produces [33.33, 33.33, 33.34]. Create tests/Unit/Services/BudgetServiceTest.php. Tests: (a) test_get_alerts_returns_over_threshold_budgets — create budget of 100 for a category, create paid expense of 85 against that category for the same month, call getAlerts(year, month), assert 1 alert returned. (b) test_copy_previous_copies_all_budgets — create 2 budgets for month M, call copyPrevious(year, M+1), assert 2 budgets for M+1 exist. Create tests/Unit/Services/GoalServiceTest.php. Tests: (a) test_progress_percent_calculation — create goal with target=1000, deposited=250, assert 25% progress. (b) test_completed_goal_status — create goal with deposited >= target, assert status is 'completed' or isPaused() returns expected value. Create tests/Unit/Helpers/UtmTest.php to test App\Support\Utm::fromRequest — pass a fake Request with utm_source/utm_medium query params, assert returned array contains those keys; pass a request with unknown 'hack' param, assert it is not in the returned array.
acceptance_criteria: tests/Feature/WalletCrudTest.php exists with 6 tests all passing
tests/Feature/GoalCrudTest.php exists with 4 tests all passing
tests/Feature/CategoryBudgetCrudTest.php exists with 6 tests all passing
tests/Feature/ReportExportTest.php exists with 4 tests all passing
tests/Feature/ApiV1Test.php exists with 5 tests all passing
tests/Feature/Security/CsrfProtectionTest.php, RateLimitTest.php, HoneypotTest.php, XssInjectionTest.php each exist with >=1 test passing
tests/Feature/CalculatorSmokeTest.php exists with 2 tests (covering all 14 routes) passing
tests/Unit/Services/TransactionServiceTest.php, BudgetServiceTest.php, GoalServiceTest.php each exist with >=2 tests passing
composer test — total test suite passes with zero failures
verification: composer test — all tests including new ones pass, zero failures, zero errors
findings: 1) PayInvoiceRequest had a bug: $this->route('id') was used but the route parameter is named 'wallet' (not 'id'). Fixed to $this->route('wallet') ?? $this->route('id') ?? '' so Rule::notIn works correctly. Existing tests (WalletAccessTest) still pass — they relied on Rule::exists (not Rule::notIn). 2) Budget copy tests (CategoryBudgetCrudTest::test_copy_previous_month_duplicates_budgets and BudgetServiceTest::test_copy_previous_copies_all_budgets) must use distinct category_id per budget, NOT category_id=null (general budgets). copyFromPreviousMonth skips duplicates by category_id — multiple null-category budgets collapse to 1 copy. 3) All 14 new test files and PayInvoiceRequest.php were committed on feature/phase11-ui-refactor (commit f3565ada). 4) composer test result: 1113 tests total (1098 pass, 15 skip, 0 fail). 5) tests/Feature/ReportExportTest.php was an existing tracked file that was overwritten — subsequent FEATs should not conflict with it. 6) The UtmTest.php is in tests/Unit/Helpers/ (new directory). 7) Security tests (CsrfProtection, RateLimit, Honeypot, XssInjection) use PHPUnit class format with declare(strict_types=1), consistent with other FEAT-003 tests (not Pest function style like HardeningTest.php).
